# Bloub animation engine

Source: https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub
Revision: b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749
License: MIT (included in LICENSE).

Runtime files from src/bot are kept unchanged. StudioBot.tsx supplies the React
renderer, semantic studio colors, visibility cleanup and reduced-motion support.
The upstream Vue app and export editor are not bundled. This is a community
recreation; the MIT license covers code, not x.ai / Grok names or character design.
